description: Searches Midvash's Bible study library: chapter commentaries, Bible characters, dictionary entries, and theology articles, in 9 languages. Use this for background and explanation — who a person was, what a term means, what a chapter is about. For the biblical text itself, use search_bible or get_passage. Results are summaries with a link to the full article.

language.description: Optional language for the study material: en, pt-br, es, fr, de, it, zh, ru, ko. Defaults to the connection language, or English.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 10; max: 25.

query.description: Words to search for across titles and summaries. Every word must appear, in any order. Accents and letter case are ignored.

type.description: Optional filter. "commentary" for chapter commentaries, "character" for people in the Bible, "dictionary" for term definitions, "theology" for doctrinal articles. Omit to search all four.

name: search_study
